title: Canonical semilinear proper/open adjunction mate
statement: Let $u$ be a universe, $C_n$ commutative rings in universe $u+1$ and $\tau_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$ arbitrary ring homomorphisms. Use the simultaneous derived semilinear-system categories and the specified adjunctions $P_h\dashv R_h$ and open extensions $J_j$ of [def-sp-semilinear-constant-ring-operations]. For schemes $V,W,S,T$ in universe $u$, let $k:V\to W$ and $i:S\to T$ be quasi-compact open immersions, let $r:V\to S$ and $p:W\to T$ be proper, and fix $h:pk=ir$. Let $\alpha_Q:P_pJ_i\to J_kP_r$ be the canonical intrinsic comparison of [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons]. Define $\gamma_Q:R_rJ_i\to J_kR_p$ to be the adjunction mate of $\alpha_Q$ under the specified $P_r\dashv R_r$ and $P_p\dashv R_p$, using [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. This defines an actual natural transformation on the ordinary derived system categories, before evaluation. The square need not be Cartesian; this definition asserts no invertibility or pasting law.
